title: Tcard_CM7-16.2.0.135SP15-OP006PF001AZ_a15
description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
CM7-16.2.0.135SP15(OP006PF001AZ)

Android Version:
1. Upgraded from Android 15 to Android 16 for enhanced security, more features, and a better user experience.

OS Version:
1. Upgraded from HiOS 15.1.2 to HiOS 16.2.0 for a smarter user interface and a refreshed look for your device.

Camera
1. Optimized the camera interaction experience for smoother and more convenient operation.
2. Improved image quality in FlashSnap mode for clearer shots.
3. Added AI editing features in AI Gallery: AI Flare Remover, AI Shadow Remover, and AI Reflection Remover.

Ella
1. Redesigned the client interface, delivering a cleaner layout, smoother operation, and an upgraded overall user experience.
2. Added AI features such as FlashMemo, MindHub, Image Style Transfer, and Document Scanner to make work and daily life more convenient.
3. Added support for more languages for smoother communication.
4. Features may vary by OS version and device model.

AI Suggestions
1. Added localized service cards, system service cards, and lifestyle service cards, with richer suggested scenarios and card types.
2. Optimized transition animations for more natural interactions.

Call
1. Supported noise suppression and voice enhancement for multiple voice call scenarios, including voice recording, phone calls, social apps, meeting apps, and gaming apps, with three levels available in Dialer and Settings.

AI Writing
1. Added AI Compose, which supports generating text based on custom prompts or intelligently polishing existing content to meet a wide range of writing needs.
2. Added Email Assistant. Designed for email scenarios, it lets you create emails with one tap, intelligently refines content, and provides smart, context-based reply suggestions to improve email communication efficiency.
3. Supported quick access to AI Writing. Added an AI Writing entry to the keyboard toolbar, so you can open the feature panel with one tap and get writing assistance anytime.

Superfluidity
1. Introduced an all-new "Superfluid" visual language, bringing a clearer, more translucent glass-like look to the system UI.
2. With deep adaptation across everyday scenarios such as the lock screen, home screen, control center, and system controls, the system now delivers a more seamless, immersive, and refined visual experience.

Wallpapers
1. Added the Depth-Effect Homescreen feature that lets you enable a depth effect with uploaded portrait wallpapers or built-in wallpapers, giving the home screen a more layered look.
2. Added 3D Wallpapers, allowing you to turn a static image into a dynamic wallpaper with a 3D spatial effect in one tap for a more layered and immersive home screen experience.
3. Supported setting live photos as live wallpapers to bring vivid moments back to life.

AI Theme Generator
1. Supported generating a theme that matches the style or colors of an uploaded static wallpaper.

Dynamic Port
1. Added real-time reminders for scenarios such as travel and food delivery, and added support to access services such as flashlight and file transfer, so important information is clear at a glance.
2. Added AI features that support quick service suggestions when copying text, as well as smart services for scenarios such as document downloads and screenshots, delivering a more convenient intelligent experience.
3. Optimized the interactive visual design. When multiple services are active, tap the stacked capsules to expand waterfall cards, so the status of multiple service activities is visible at a glance for improved efficiency.
